description: A fast castle with Grand Fulani Corral build to pump Sofas and Archers. This build bases its economy heavily on passive income, so securing these passive income sources is vital to the succes of this playstyle.
name: S5 Cow Boom into Sofa/Archer
author: Valdemar1902

notes: When 150@https://age4builder.com/img/resourcewoodicon.webp@ take all 5@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.png@</img> from straggler tree to @https://age4builder.com/img/sheep.png@</img>

@https://age4builder.com/img/age2dark.webp@ 5@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.png@</img> goes to @https://age4builder.com/img/goldminingcamp.png@</img>@https://age4builder.com/img/resourcegoldicon.png@</img>. Build @https://age4builder.com/img/lumbercamp.png@</img> when done with straggler trees. Build a @building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.png@</img>
@resource/cattle.png@</img>  should be 6 with a 4x4 tile space for the @landmark_malians/grand-fulani-corral-2.png@</img> Landmark. + Now you should start building a 2nd

Keep adding more production and build up a big army mainly of @unit_malians/sofa-2.webp@  and @https://age4builder.com/img/archer2.png@</img>. Consider setting up trade now as well, and produce siege for pushing. Don't forget @https://age4builder.com/img/blacksmith.png@</img>As usual with greedy builds like this, remember to make units in feudal for defending, if your opponent looks to try and deal damage early on.
Send 5x @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ from @landmark_malians/mansa-quarry-2.png@ to build 1x @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ and then farm @resource/resource_gold.png@
*If opponent is being aggressive, build counter units*

5 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and chop 150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ then to @resource/resource_food.webp@. 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ and build 7 @building_economy/house.webp@

@resource/rally.webp@1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to a 2nd @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and chop an additional 25 @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Then @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_food.webp@
Gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ then switch to @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@. @resource/rally.webp@ until 10 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@
When you have 2 donsos and 2 javs then go and build 2nd @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@
Take 5 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ and go on @resource/deer.webp@ and build a @building_malians/toll-outpost-1.webp@
Now you start cow booming and continue to make units. Minimum 12 cows b4 age 3. Don't be afraid to push opponent if they go castle.
Full @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ @unit_malians/sofa-2.webp@. Take @resource/relics.webp@ and play the game out with heavy raiding and expansion.

name: Malian Cow Boom / fast Castle against aggro Civs
author: Nobu

notes: 1@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.webp@ to build @building_malians/pit-mine-1.png@ + 6@https://age4builder.com/img/house.png@ / 5 @https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.png@   to one straggler tree
When 150@https://age4builder.com/img/resourcewoodicon.webp@ take all 5@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.png@ from straggler tree to @https://age4builder.com/img/sheep.png@
1@unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ starts building a @building_military/barracks.png@ for @unit_malians/donso-1.png@ against cav
NOTE: If the opponent makes early MAA just build some @unit_malians/musofadi-warrior-2.png@ to kill em

description: Transcribed version of Vortix's build order that consists of harassing with a few Warriors Scouts and Sofas, while producing Archers to defend, and build a Cow Boom behind it. That way you delay the opponent while having your Castle composition ready to be upgraded.
name: Vortix's Feudal Aggro with Sofas into Cow Boom
author: Eldritch

notes: Send 5 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to collect 1 full @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and then send back to @resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up
Send 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to build @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ and then 6 @building_economy/house.webp@ around it, then back to @resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up
Build @landmark_malians/mansa-quarry-2.webp@ with 4 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ in front of your base
Build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ with the next @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ from @building_economy/town-center.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 8
@resource/rally.webp@ 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and build @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ and leave them to mine
@resource/rally.webp@ 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ and build @building_economy/mill.webp@ and leave them to gather

Send 3 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ from @landmark_malians/mansa-quarry-2.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ and 1 to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to have 8 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ in total with the @resource/berrybush.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ once you have 10 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ including the 2 building the @building_military/stable.webp@
Once @building_economy/mill.webp@ is built, produce 3 @resource/cattle.webp@ and send them where you'll build your first @building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.webp@
When @building_military/stable.webp@ is built, research @unit_malians/warrior-scout-2.webp@ Veteran upgrade and then queue 1 @unit_malians/warrior-scout-2.webp@  and start harassing the opponent
If safe to do so, build a second @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ and @building_economy/house.webp@
If unsafe, build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and make @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ first to secure the location if possible
Build a second @building_economy/mill.webp@ to produce @resource/cattle.webp@ while @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ researches in the other one
Produce @unit_malians/sofa-2.webp@ as soon as possible to continue harassing the opponent, and keep producing them
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ whenever possible to defend and start making @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 8 and research @technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@, then @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

description: Build order of Valdemar Uploaded by jimmy. Edited by me.
name: Cow Boom and Fast Castle [eng]
author: Pilsen

notes: 5x @unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ until cut it entirely . Then ->
When you reach @age/age_2.webp@, 5x@unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ of @landmark_malians/mansa-quarry-2.png@ go to @building_economy/mining-camp.png@@resource/resource_gold.png@
Build another @building_economy/mill.webp@ to produce @resource/cattle.png@ there too
Create @building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.png@ and @resource/cattle.png@  until the maximun amount.
@resource/rally.png@ to @resource/resource_food.png@ until you have 8x villager there
Eat @resource/sheep.png@ if still are, if not eat @resource/cattle.png@
If you can, build another @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ (if the enemy doesn't attack)
When finished, the@unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ builders of @landmark_malians/grand-fulani-corral-2.png@ go to@resource/resource_wood.png@
Attention! This is an ideal build where the enemy
does not attack during the feudal age.
If they do attack in feudal, you will be forced to create
buildings and military units to defend yourself.

description: Idk how to make these, first time, just doing it since i didn't find it on here and i find it easier to follow a guide like this. Also since im new to the game, i won't be adding exact time stamps since i can't keep up with them.
name: Beasty S10/11 greedy cow boom
author: Kahtlane Isik

notes: One on pit mine, other five on straggler tree@resource/resource_wood.webp@, queue them to sheep, to go there after they finish the tree@resource/resource_wood.png@  Send 1 Vil to make pit mine @building_malians/pit-mine-1.png@ and 6 houses around it @building_economy/house.png@, with the wood gained from the trees

queue first Villager from TC to single straggler tree@building_economy/town-center.webp@ @resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@ and then the rest on food @building_economy/town-center.png@@resource/rally.png@@resource/sheep.png@@resource/resource_food.png@
Also don't forget to scout and gather sheep , you will run out around 2:30

Single villager on wood will gather last resources for the 6 houses@building_economy/house.webp@. After u start building the sixth house, get him on food @resource/sheep.png@@resource/resource_food.png@
Rally all units until u get enough resources from age up onto food.@building_economy/town-center.webp@@resource/rally.png@@resource/sheep.png@@resource/resource_food.png@

You should now have around 13-14 villagers@unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ for the time of the age-up, which will be Mansa Quarry @landmark_malians/mansa-quarry-2.png@, get 4 workers@unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ from food onto the age-up.

Once you start the age-up, move 5 villages from @resource/sheep.webp@@resource/resource_food.png@ over to straggler tree @resource/resource_wood.png@ and rally TC onto wood @building_economy/town-center.png@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@.

Build a lumbercamp on the woodline@building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ with the villagers on trees@resource/resource_wood.png@ after the straggler tree is depleted.  Send one villager @unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ from the straggler to make a Mill @building_economy/mill.png@. He places it on Berries@resource/berrybush.png@.  And send the villager @unit_worker/villager-malians.png@building the mill back on wood@resource/resource_wood.png@. Also add one more Mill @building_economy/mill.png@next to woodline with a worker@unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ from there.
Rally TC on Gold.@building_economy/town-center.webp@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_gold.png@ And build Mining camp @building_economy/mining-camp.png@on gold @resource/resource_gold.png@

Send the AGE-UP Villagers to 2 on gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@and 2 on wood@resource/resource_wood.png@. Start making Cows @resource/cattle.png@ and Cattle Ranches @building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.png@ .

Start making Second Pitmine on the next gold@building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@@resource/resource_gold.png@ and build 6 houses @building_economy/house.png@ and a mining camp @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ around it.
U should now be getting your 20 Cows@resource/cattle.webp@@building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.png@

Add Production building@building_military/barracks.webp@@building_military/archery-range.png@  to defend whatever u might be getting harrased by to not lose anything. @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ vs @unit_malians/donso-1.png@(spearmen) @unit_malians/donso-1.png@ vs @unit_malians/sofa-2.png@(horsemen)

Rally onto food until age-up. @building_economy/market.webp@@resource/rally.png@@resource/sheep.png@@resource/resource_food.png@ Unless getting fully harrased or all-in by enemy. Then add more production buildings@building_military/barracks.png@@building_military/archery-range.png@ and make units accordingly @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ vs @unit_malians/donso-1.png@(spearmen) @unit_malians/donso-1.png@ vs @unit_malians/sofa-2.png@(horsemen)

Get the 8 workers @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@you have gathered on food@resource/resource_food.png@ on the age-up, which will be Grand Fullani Corral@landmark_malians/grand-fulani-corral-2.png@.

Rally Tc on to wood@building_economy/town-center.webp@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@, no more food gathering is needed because of the cowboom@resource/cattle.png@@resource/cattle.png@@resource/cattle.png@.

As your aging up, start making your eco upgrades. @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@@technology_economy/specialized-pick.png@@technology_economy/horticulture.png@

Send a villager from wood to start making production buildings, preferably @building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/stable.png@@building_military/stable.png@@building_military/archery-range.png@@building_military/archery-range.png@
Start producing the best Malian Comp, Sofa@unit_malians/sofa-2.png@ + Archers @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@

Send 4 villagers@unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ from age-up to Gold@resource/resource_gold.png@ and 4 to Wood@resource/resource_wood.png@ . Instantly build a mosque @building_religious/mosque.png@ and produce @unit_religious/monk-3.png@

Get veteran upgrades@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@@unit_malians/sofa-2.png@ and unique upgrades @technology_malians/imported-armor-3.png@@technology_malians/poisoned-arrows-3.png@ for ur units, add blacksmith @building_technology/blacksmith.png@for upgrades as well @technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@@technology_military/balanced-projectiles.png@@technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@@technology_military/wedge-rivets.png@@technology_military/bloomery.png@@technology_military/decarbonization.png@. Good luck!

description: Pro scouts into mass units. This build is aggressive and has a lot of utility and different choices you can make in your games. Read the guide for directions :)
name: Fast Pro Scouts (S9)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 5 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ and chop 150 @resource/resource_wood.png@. 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ to @building_malians/pit-mine-1.png@ and build 7 @building_economy/house.png@

@resource/rally.webp@1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ to a 2nd @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ and chop an additional 25 @resource/resource_wood.png@. Then @resource/rally.png@ @resource/resource_food.png@
@building_military/barracks.webp@ & start taking deer when @technology_economy/professional-scouts.png@ is finished
If enemy makes spears then build an @building_military/archery-range.webp@ for @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ and @unit_malians/javelin-thrower-2.png@ for enemy ranged
Think about adding in a 2nd @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@, if the game is in your control

If you start to run out of deer in base, then do a small cow transition and go @landmark_malians/grand-fulani-corral-2.webp@. If enemy is weak and you can go age 3 for a timing with a lot of present units on the field, then go @landmark_malians/farimba-garrison-2.png@ for upgrades.
Malians have good utility for fighting up an age. If enemy is going castle, don't be afraid to continue making units to raid and even end the game.
Mass @unit_malians/javelin-thrower-2.png@ for anything really (can be upgraded with farimba to @unit_malians/javelin-thrower-mansa.png@ for a lot of extra damage)
@unit_malians/sofa-2.png@ do well against MAA type units too (not super strong vs mass ranged due to lack of ranged armor)
